runtime.head_policy: Record actual canonical HEADs and installed content SHA at launch, do not pin final execution to this observation

authority.material_externalization: Reuse existing permanent authorization for the approved public/source excerpt scope; no document-by-document human signature
authority.provider: Use existing authorization and an explicit actually configured provider; no new provider-by-provider signature
authority.platform_approval: Platform enforcement remains active; do not claim it can be disabled; retain real approval/rejection outcomes
authority.raw_and_production: Protect original bytes and production config/catalog; storage owner supplies mFresh environment
authority.review: No per-step signoff; seal research then four independent review roles

budgets.policy: Allocation includes all paid operations for a company. AUTO reserve/settle receipts remain authoritative; known and unknown are distinct. Refresh native mother scope at launch; no R3 double counting or second budget DB.

deadline.propagation: Pass positive remaining seconds to source preparation, native/public narrative read, finite batch and HTTP transport; bounded outer recorder covers operation and cleanup
deadline.exhausted: Refuse operation and retain deadline gap; no zero/unbounded or silent new deadline
deadline.failure: Do not reopen paid batch on public read timeout or automatically retry unknown charge

protocol.financial_sources: RF source_preparation result-envelope → actual FF2.0 intent → CWP verified raw source/capture
protocol.official_registered_sources: prepare_registered_source_result(genuine candidate, explicit catalog, remaining deadline, explicit receipt version)
protocol.source_availability_opt_in: 2.2, explicit capability; exact-SHA prior proof only where producer can certify it
protocol.narrative: configured finite batch + public reference/read + selected span→claim→used parameter→native formula receipt
protocol.formal: lint → fix input-side hashes → validate-only → compute/render → native registry → immutable snapshot

known_preflight_limitations: Generated template is incomplete, not a passed business input; defaults and placeholders must be replaced from real scope/source outputs.
Unknown publication is not accepted by the current historical narrative-read wire; raw source-reader2.2 proof capability is distinct.
Observed configuration is not a network success/vision/pricing proof; OpenAI configuration currently unavailable.
OCR partial source coverage and table/reading-order/omission limitations persist; selected exact replay is not full recall.
Mother historical unknown reservations remain seven, not free or settled by this preparation.
